hamilton-2015-nelson-chart.citation: Hamilton, Donohue, Hall, Leben, Quian, Sheinbaum and Watts (2015), Observations and Dynamics of the Loop Current, BOEM2015-006, February2015.
hamilton-2015-nelson-chart.access: Original BOEM report SHA-verified; Figure5.2-6(p), printed253/PDF283, its extracted original1092x898 chart and Table5.2-2 printed255/PDF285 actual pixels reviewed. Explicit Nelson label. Mixed solid/dashed frontal-analysis extent read manually; inner drifter tracks excluded. Source raster, placement, published axis boxes and chart-data week verified on one idle local CPU.

records.period_label: EddyWatch chart data26August-1September1989; report separation date and registry initial separation remain separate
records.case_label: Nelson explicitly named historical frontal-analysis chart; physical identity unverified
records.source_locator: BOEM2015-006 Figure5.2-6(p), printed253/PDF283; Table5.2-2, printed255/PDF285 gives26August-1September1989 chart-data range. Original embedded chart explicitly labels Nelson Eddy.
records.definition: Geographic east–west bounding span of the manually read outer Nelson frontal-analysis envelope, including the original dashed western front and excluding inner drifter tracks and the separate Loop Current.
records.scope: Historical source-chart frontal-analysis extent, not a verified full physical eddy boundary. No principal width, diameter, radius or area inferred.
records.qualification: Mixed solid/dashed original front read manually; original dashed segments are not repaired and no closed topology inferred. Six native raster pixels per extremum and fixed25km outward reporting are reading sensitivity only. Frontal-analysis error, line interpretation, scan/axis distortion and physical uncertainty remain unquantified. Source chart-data week is not an exact simultaneous observation. Report1September1989 separation and registry24February1989 initial separation remain unreconciled. Inner drifter tracks, Loop Current continuation and local ADCP current-phase measurements do not supply these bounds. No footprint, state containment, ranking, annual range or seasonal playback inferred.
